scope: Original restore queue ends/order and actual future-ETA versus active prefetch; no native implementation acceptance

actual_queue_rules.producer: LPUSH, consumed from right; existing queued C thenD observed right-pop C,D.
actual_queue_rules.warm_restore: Original OrderedDict delivered insertion A,B is RPUSHed A,B; right-pop order B,A before existing C,D.
actual_queue_rules.visible_restore: Original ZREVRANGEBYSCORE visits newer aged score first; RPUSH reversal gives older reservation first in right-pop order.
actual_queue_rules.equal_score_restore: Redis descending tag lexical iteration is reversed by RPUSH/right-pop, yielding ascending tag lexical delivery; labels are not a tie-breaker.

failed_attempt: 118 had a wrong fixture expectation for random delivery-tag ties; actual observed lists preserved;119 derives tie expectation from tags.
limitations: Warm/visible queued-marker cases invoke unchanged Original QoS directly; the eight-ETA warm-stop case uses the real Original worker.
Aged scores are controlled fixture timestamps, not an actual one-hour wait.
Native ETA reservation count/bytes need independent explicit resource bounds; ordinary active prefetch4 is not an ETA reservation cap.
